title: Chapter 1030
text:
In the unexplored area of the Emerald Star Cluster, a high warp speed spaceship was hyperdrive.

There was only Han Xiao and a portion of the Apostle Weapons in the spaceship. He sat in the command room and looked at the star map. The target marked in red was flashing on the screen. The coordinates were somewhere in the middle of the Emerald Star Cluster.

This was the location of the birth of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy that was revealed in EsGod's inheritance. The various organizations had not explored this place yet, so he drove the advanced spaceship that he had built and did not need to stop along the way like the other organizations.

The birth of the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy was not far away, so he went to wait in the bushes.

Because of Evans, only Han Xiao knew that this coordinate was correct. The other organizations that had received information about the Primal Chaos Mysterious Energy still needed to try their luck at the coordinates shown in the data. This could reduce some of the competitors, which was very beneficial to him.

Han Xiao's main body went out to be safe. If the competitors were not strong, he could just send his Lord's Avatar to deal with them. This way, he would not have to expose his main body's location.

However, at this time, Han Xiao planned to find a place to stay. He finally had enough experience to reach level 320, and his Promotion was the top priority.

During this time, he had been rushing. The foundation for the development of the Black Star Corps had been set up, so he did not need to worry. As long as he waited for the foreign players to come to the Flickering World, the army would automatically attract new players.

Currently, the number of players in the army had reached about eight million, and this was far from the limit. When the remaining Star Field players came to the World Server, the number of players in the army would easily break through the ten million mark. They would continue to replenish new blood and gain a large amount of experience.

"When all the players gather in the World Server, the number of players in the army should reach about 11.5 million. It will temporarily be the largest player faction, second only to the three Universal Civilizations in the later versions of my previous life."

Han Xiao thought to himself.

Currently, not all the players had come to the Flickering World, but the players had already attracted the attention of the various organizations. The situation was developing toward the early stages of Version 4.0 that he was familiar with in his previous life.

Because of his existence, the tens of millions of players who were supposed to be scattered were now in the Black Star Corps. This would cause some changes, but Han Xiao was already mentally prepared for this. The phase of making a fortune through the players was over, and soon, the various major organizations would value the players' abilities as much as he did.

"Let's not think about this for now. Anyway, I'm in a good situation now. I'm sitting on the fishing platform." Han Xiao shook his head. He made the ship slow down and stop in space.

Han Xiao exited the cabin and flew away from the spaceship with his physical body. He let the Apostle Weapons protect him and turned on the device that hid the energy waves to hide the changes during his advancement.

Opening the interface, Han Xiao looked at the astronomical amount of experience points. He could not wait any longer.

"I've finally accumulated enough EXP to level up. It's been a long time since I've experienced this feeling of flying."

With that thought in mind, he did not hesitate and invested all his experience points into leveling up. His level, which had been stagnant for a long time, once again shot up like a rocket!

[Divine Throne Mechanic] leveled up to LV8. + 450 Energy, + 5 STR, + 5 DEX, + 15 END, + 20 INT. You have received 15 AP and 1 Potential Point.

…

[Divine Throne Mechanic] leveled up to LV20. + 450 Energy, + 5 STR, + 5 DEX, + 15 END, + 20 INT. You have received 15 AP and 1 Potential Point.

You have reached LV 320. You have triggered the LV 320 Promotion Mission!

Lv 320 Promotion Mission completed!

Promotion successful!

+ 90 Basic END Bonus! 1 END = 570 Health = 580 Stamina

[Tyracles Mechanical Legacy] Lv.320 Special Blueprint unlocked!

Your Energy Level has reached Lv.21. Your Energy Rank has exceeded 78000.

You have received the talent [God's Trait Transformation-Machinery (0/?)]

You have received the talent [God's Trait Transformation-Void (0/?)]

You have received 2 God's Trait Transformation Points.

You have received 1 [The First Sanctum] Ability Fragment.

All Virtual Technology-type Skills have their effects increased by 50%.

Han Xiao's entire body shook. Every cell of his seemed to have become a black hole, swallowing the surrounding dark energy to improve his own cells.

The upper limit of the [Divine Throne Mechanic] class was LV 60, and he could only change his class at LV 360. The next Species Evolution would be at LV 340.

In Han Xiao's impression, LV 320 was supposed to be a normal Promotion, but the notification that popped up on the interface made him excited.

"God's Trait Transformation?"

Han Xiao's eyes sparkled.

He was not completely unfamiliar with this term. In the later versions of his previous life, this concept had spread in the Beyond Grade A circle, and the players knew about it. Although there was very little information, according to the guesses on the forums, this should be an important factor in increasing one's life level.

At the very least, his Mechanical Deity had the word 'God' in it. In terms of Divinity, the [Key of Adeptus Mechanicus] seemed to be similar … However, he had never experienced what Divinity was before.

Why is it that the higher one's life level, the more idealistic it becomes? This makes it very difficult for a materialistic Mechanic like me …

So, 78000 Ona Energy Rank and LV 21 Energy Rank is the threshold to trigger the God's Trait Transformation? Han Xiao thought to himself as he endured the pain of his Promotion.

The calculation of Energy Rank was a rather complicated function, and it was not as simple as adding and subtracting. The larger the number, the greater the actual difference between each point. For example, the difference between 200 and 100 Energy Rank was the same as the difference between 10000 and 9,900 Energy Rank. They were both '100', but the difference between the two was like heaven and earth. The higher one's Energy Rank was, the harder it would be to increase it.

When he broke through LV 300 and became a Mechanical Deity, his Energy Rank was 71000.

In the next decade or so, he continuously trained in new Energy Training Techniques and increased the upper limit of his Energy Rank by a lot. He also spent a lot of EXP and Potential Points to increase his skills and knowledge. At the same time, he also obtained powerful talents and skills from Heber, Manison, Yin Ying, and the others. He also obtained [Perfect Mechanical Sense] from Nero. With all these bonuses, his Energy Rank had steadily exceeded 78000.

"The two God's Trait Transformations are Machinery and Void respectively … Hmm, they should correspond to my main class and race, so are they two different evolution paths? Or do they have to start from the same starting point? "

Han Xiao looked at the list of talents. There was a small '+' behind the two God's Trait Transformations talents, and the effect of the talents was a question mark.

"Looks like I'll only know the effect after adding the points. The Promotion gave me two God's Trait Transformation points, so I'll try adding one to both of them … The suffix should represent the upper limit of this talent, and I'll only be considered to have completed this talent after I've filled it up. However, it's also a question mark. I wonder how many points I need to add … "

With that thought in mind, Han Xiao tentatively added a point to [God's Trait Transformation-Machinery], and the effect of the talent immediately appeared.

[God's Trait Transformation-Machinery (1/?)]

First Stage: + 1,000% Machinery Affinity, + 20% Ability Strength, + 20% Basic Effect of all Mechanic Class Skills slightly increased.

Han Xiao looked at the skill list. The increase in the basic effect of the skills meant that the increase of each level would slightly increase. The enhancement of all the Mechanic Class Skills on his body was not high, but it was comprehensive.

"The bonuses are not bad, but it doesn't feel that powerful … Maybe it's because it's only the first stage? The more points I add, the more powerful the effect? "Han Xiao raised his brows. This made sense.

[God's Trait Transformation-Void (1/?)]

First Stage: Exclusive Racial Talent increased. The Racial Talent of the Void Evolution Path has been slightly increased. You have received 1,750 Free Attribute Points.

[Mechanical Genius] Machinery Affinity increased from 1.25x to 1.28x, and the Machinery Creation Ability bonus increased from 40% to 44%. The other Racial Talents of the Void Evolution Path were also more or less increased, reducing the cooldown by quite a bit.

"This is not bad."

Han Xiao nodded.

He had spent all his God's Trait Transformation Points, and he did not know how to replenish them. Would they only be given when he advanced, or were there other ways to obtain them?

If they were only given when he advanced, it would mean that the earlier he reached the requirement of 78000 Energy Rank, the earlier he would be able to obtain God's Trait Transformation Points. When his level was low, it would naturally be more convenient for him to advance, and he would be able to obtain more points than when he advanced. Perhaps this represented his potential?

Han Xiao shook his head and looked at the other notification.

What is this [The First Sanctum] Ability Fragment? He had never heard of it in his previous life.

The introduction was also filled with question marks. Han Xiao did not understand what it was. From the name [The First Sanctum], it did not seem to have anything to do with Mechanics. Currently, he only had one Ability Fragment, so he could not use it even if he wanted to, so he could only look at it.

"I feel like this is a key factor … I'll find a chance to ask the dynasty if they have any information on this. I'll probably need to exchange it for Contribution Points, just like the information on the Machinery Faith."

Han Xiao tossed the things he did not understand to the back of his mind and looked at the [Tyracles Mechanical Legacy]. Some new blueprints would be unlocked at level 320 and 360. At this moment, he had unlocked a level 320 blueprint.

He quickly scanned through it, and his eyes suddenly focused, revealing a look of surprise.

F * ck, I've struck gold!
